The '''Battle of Svoshchensk Forestry''' was a late-1953 battle during the [[Nogoyevian War of Independence]]. It occurred as Nogoyevian forces pushed the retreating Zhensanovian army toward the border.

The battle was fought in dense woodland and rugged terrain. Zhensanov committed the 41st Air Assault Division to stop the Nogoyevian advance, but the division suffered heavy losses and could not hold its positions.

== Outcome ==

Zhensanovian forces retreated across the border, leaving Nogoyevian territory. The battle marked the effective end of large-scale ground combat inside Nogoyev.

Afterward, the war shifted toward border clashes, diplomacy, and eventual ceasefire negotiations.
